title: What is an isolated system
topic: the concept of an isolated system in thermodynamics
persona_summary: Student gives a partially correct answer — they grasp 'no exchange with outside' but conflate isolated, closed and open systems. Goal: tutor must surface the partial vs. complete understanding through questioning.
turns: An isolated system is one that doesn't exchange anything with its surroundings.
I think it doesn't let energy or matter in or out.
Wait, isn't that the same as a closed system though?
Hmm, maybe a closed system blocks matter but not energy?
So an isolated system blocks both? Energy AND matter?
